limits: Single random seed per illustrative30day regime; not a forecast or annual return gate.
Gas is a fixed keeper quote; actual caller gas beyond explicitly identified proxies is not modeled.
Holder end value includes independently marked assets and unharvested fees; not realized exit cash.
Minimum free cash sampled at initialization and after successful keeper calls, not a continuous minimum.
Exact vault model reconciled with fresh real fork traces; forward stochastic external-event approximations are not fork replay.
